description: GeoStudio is a geotechnical modelling suite in 2D and 3D whose products cover slope stability (SLOPE/W), groundwater seepage (SEEP/W), stress and deformation (SIGMA/W), dynamic earthquake response (QUAKE/W) and ground heat transfer (TEMP/W), which can be coupled so that, for example, pore pressures from a seepage run feed a stability analysis. It is produced by Seequent, The Bentley Subsurface Company, part of Bentley Systems. Coverage is global, with applications named on the page including earth and tailings dams, natural and cut slopes, and embankments. It is sold as desktop software through direct sales, subscriptions and academic licences; no prices were shown on the page read. Caveats: it is proprietary, results depend on the soil properties and boundary conditions supplied, and the product page does not give technical limits of each module. For simulation it models how rainfall, reservoir level changes and earthquakes affect the stability of tailings dams, water dams and transport embankments, supporting hazard exposure and resilience studies of mining and water infrastructure. It is related to the Rocscience and Leapfrog Geo records in this catalogue, another geotechnical suite and Seequent's geological modelling tool.
